title: Algebra Essentials: Key Terms & Rules
description: Core algebra vocabulary, properties, and exponent rules to review before a test or a new math course.
subject: math

cards.definition: A symbol, usually a letter, that stands for an unknown or changing value.
a(b + c) = ab + ac. Multiply the outside factor by each term inside the parentheses.
y = mx + b, where m is the slope of the line and b is the y-intercept.
The number multiplied by a variable in a term, such as 5 in 5x.
A term with a fixed value that does not change, such as 7 in 3x + 7.
A single number, variable, or product of numbers and variables, separated from other terms by + or − signs.
Terms with the same variables raised to the same powers, such as 3x² and −5x². Combine them by adding their coefficients.
A combination of numbers, variables, and operations with no equals sign, such as 4x − 9.
A statement that two expressions are equal, such as 2x + 3 = 11.
A statement that compares two expressions using <, >, ≤, or ≥.
Parentheses, exponents, multiplication and division (left to right), then addition and subtraction (left to right). Often remembered as PEMDAS.
Changing the order doesn't change a sum or product: a + b = b + a and ab = ba.
Changing the grouping doesn't change a sum or product: (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) and (ab)c = a(bc).
Operations that undo each other, such as addition and subtraction. Used to isolate a variable when solving an equation.
The steepness of a line, rise over run: m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁).
The point where a line crosses the y-axis, where x = 0.
x^m · x^n = x^(m + n). When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents.
x^m / x^n = x^(m − n) for x ≠ 0. When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents.
(x^m)^n = x^(mn). When raising a power to a power, multiply the exponents.
Any nonzero number raised to the power 0 equals 1: x^0 = 1 for x ≠ 0.
x^(−n) = 1 / x^n for x ≠ 0. A negative exponent means take the reciprocal.
First, Outer, Inner, Last: a method for multiplying two binomials, such as (x + 2)(x + 3).
a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b).
x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) / (2a). Solves any equation of the form ax² + bx + c = 0 where a ≠ 0.
